rationale: A Russian announcement of a new offensive and ISW's later assessment that it gained little are compatible and not evidential.
The pipeline's reported route and a later statement about fire control over it are different assertions.
Both rest on the brigades Zelensky named at Izium on 14 September 2022, including the 107th and the artillery brigades; same Wikipedia source.
The wreck's computed location vs the account of the sinking: context only.
HUR's list of hits vs where the ships were caught: different assertions.
Coastal terrain and logistics vs camouflage and decoys: different facts.
The night kill of three MT-LBs is an instance of the Bradleys' ambushes on MT-LB columns; same Forbes source.
Neizhpapa's hit locations vs an estimate of expected warning time: different assertions.
A volunteer's explanation of the surrender does not bear on Russia's figure.
